audit_items.proof_trace: TOCTOU race condition exists between duplicate check (L157) and cache update (L42 in subscriber). Concurrent identical messages can both pass hasSeenDataColumnIndex check, complete full validation in parallel, then both set ValidatorData and execute subscriber logic, violating the spec requirement that only first valid sidecar be processed.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker floods multiple identical data column sidecars for same (slot, proposer_index, index) tuple from different peers simultaneously. Both messages pass L157 check concurrently before either updates cache, causing duplicate processing and resource exhaustion.
